title: Three Spaced Drums And Low Rail Cycling Rollers

A complete closed side belt embraces two separate end pulleys. Two buried cross members and four finite rubber ground pads complete the frame. All geometry newly drawn; not a scaled logistics roller conveyor, a bicycle fragment, or a modified elliptical. Four opaque PBR roles, metre units, Z up, one whole model and zero scenes.
